title: 第30章：吃瘪的江彩霞
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“大侄子，你还有啥条件不，大家伙都在，你今天一次性说完。”

    “嗯！”

    马超丝毫没有客气的意思是，他目光看向江彩霞，对方身体明显抖动了一下，但关马超什么事，既然两家关系本来就不好，他也没必要给自己找气受不是。

    “我这第三个条件就是，除了江彩霞以及和她家关系走的近的不收，其他人就按我们说好的来。”

    “凭啥不收我家的。”

    一听到这话，江彩霞仿佛被踩中尾巴的猫，直接炸了。

    “你说凭啥，就我们俩家人的关系，村里谁不知道。”

    “我家找的路子，凭啥要带上你。”

    “你你你！”

    江彩霞张着嘴半天说不出话来，周围众人心里憋着笑，以前你不是一直笑话马家，现在有钱赚知道凑上来了，晚了。

    但表面上的场面话还是要说的，“江嫂子，这事你别急，等过后你上门多说点好话，给人家道个歉。”

    “我凭啥道歉？”

    “你说凭啥。”

    众人十分无语，都到这份上了，你还想强买强卖不成，关键是，你强买强卖也要他们这些人愿意才行。

    “江彩霞，你咋说话呢。”

    “就是，我们让你道歉也是为了你好，你咋不识好歹呢。”

    “你们太欺负人了。”
content_en:
"Eldest nephew, do you have any other conditions? Everyone is here. You can finish it all at once today."

    "Yeah!"

    Ma Chao didn't mean to be polite at all. He looked at Jiang Caixia, and the other party's body trembled obviously. But it was none of Ma Chao's business. Since the relationship between the two families was not good in the first place, there was no need for him to find fault with himself.

    "My third condition is that, except for Jiang Caixia and her close relationship with her family, everyone else will come as we agreed."

    "Why don't you accept it from my family?"

    As soon as she heard this, Jiang Caixia exploded as if a cat had stepped on its tail.

    "Why do you think so? As far as the relationship between our two families is concerned, no one in the village knows about it."

    "My family found a way, why should I take you with me?"

    "You, you, you!"

    Jiang Caixia opened her mouth and couldn't speak for a long time. Everyone around her was suppressing laughter in her heart. You used to laugh at the Ma family, but now that you are making money, you know it's too late.

    But I still have to say something about the situation on the surface, "Sister-in-law Jiang, don't be anxious about this. Afterwards, you can come and say more nice things and apologize to me."

    "Why should I apologize?"

    "Why do you say that?"

    Everyone was speechless. They were already at this point. You still want to buy and sell by force. The key is that you have to be willing to buy and sell by force.

    "Jiang Caixia, why are you talking?"

    "That's right, it's for your own good that we ask you to apologize. Why don't you know what's good and what's wrong?"

    "You are such a bully."
